lesson: Post `X of N completed` progress updates parsed from the dbt log step, not just 'queued / running / done'. Use the regex `(\d+) of (\d+) (START|OK|ERROR)` on the dbt run step's log (via the dbt Cloud API debug-logs endpoint).
evidence: User explicitly asked for '6 of 10 completed' style updates in Slack rather than coarse status pings.

lesson: Polls `gh pr checks <PR>` every N minutes (default 10). Default target check name = `ci/dbt_cloud`; override with --check-name when the context was renamed (e.g. `dbtcloud-codevalidate / DBT Code Validation`). Stops at terminal state (success/failure). On success, emits the finance_dev SQL validation queries the supervisor runs via the Snowflake MCP. Posts X-of-N progress from the dbt log step (regex `(\d+) of (\d+) (START|OK|ERROR)`).

CI uses `dbt build --select state:modified+ --defer` for slim CI - this catches DOWNSTREAM dependencies of changed nodes but NOT end-to-end-chain rebuilds. For refactor PRs that change shared staging (tmp_tbls_*, stg_arr_categories_*) the CI run looks clean but the downstream ARR tables remain stale until the next scheduled run. Flag refactor PRs that touch staging with the `needs-full-pipeline` label so cd-monitor triggers the adhoc_pipeline_runner_config path post-merge.
evidence: Refactoring Code Fixes - PR #326/#327 passed CI but didn't trigger E2E.

lesson: For QA-environment full pipeline runs (when state:modified+ isn't enough), the canonical anchor is `models/stage/table/adhoc_pipeline_runner_config.sql`. Bumping its `as_was_date` constant + merging the PR triggers a full end-to-end rebuild of stage tables, finance_line_analytics, arr_line/sku/subproduct/product (excluding SCD2 wrappers). Treat this file as a deployment-time switch, NOT a routine code change.

lesson: GitHub Actions `eda-linting-runners` runner group is whitelisted ONLY for the reusable workflow `BT-DevSecOps-Github-Actions-Workflows/codevalidate-dbtcloud.yml`. Jobs defined directly in this repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` will NOT be picked up by the runner group — `workflow_dispatch` runs sit in 'queued' indefinitely. Root cause of #316 revert (rolled back #313/#314/#315 manual-run workflows). To add new dispatchable workflows, separately whitelist them via a Workday DevSecOps ticket.

`workflow_dispatch` triggers need separate runner-group whitelisting from PR-triggered jobs even when they share the same workflow file. PR-on-push works via the reusable codevalidate path; a manual button in the same file will still hang. Always test new dispatches end-to-end before relying on them for backfills.

For QA-environment full pipeline runs (when state:modified+ isn't enough), post-IA the trigger has changed. The old `models/stage/table/adhoc_pipeline_runner_config.sql` file is RETIRED. New mechanism: set dbt var `run_arr_historical_chain_standalone: true` (in dbt_project.yml or via --vars) and configure `arr_refactor_as_was_date_list: [...]` with the snapshot dates to rebuild. The `macros/em/run_historical_chains_standalone.sql` macro is the on-run-start hook that fans out the full pipeline (stg + finance_line_analytics + arr_*_categories) for each as_was_date in the list. Treat var-flips as deployment-time switches, NOT routine code changes.
